root.body: Temporary restriction for all Unleashd work, including delegated workers: do not run `sqlite3` or other direct SQLite clients against live `~/.buddies` or `~/.agent-viewer` stores until the lock-loss fix is verified. Use Buddy tools or the application's API. Restart investigation found native SIGBUS crashes in the Buddies addon and missing database locks; outside SQLite opens are suspected triggers. Reproduce only on isolated temporary stores. Leads: pass this restriction to your active workers. Details: agent_notes/2026-09-30_worker-continuity-double-audit.md; [SQLite lock repair](task:task_01a0f2cb-29d1-777b-a62a-508abae5baf3).
